chunks.title: Characterize and make the position contract explicit
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests capture the current public game-state and move-result contract, including no-mutation failures
Rules state explicitly represents active color, board, move history, and eligibility data required by later orthodox rules
Rules code remains independent of HTTP input, rendering, and PHP session access

chunks.title: Generate legal orthodox moves with king safety
acceptance_criteria: Every ordinary piece's moves and captures are generated deterministically from explicit state
Legal-move filtering rejects self-check, wrong-side moves, friendly captures, blocked paths, and terminal-state moves without mutation
Focused tests cover legal and illegal examples for each ordinary piece plus check evasion

chunks.title: Implement complete special-move eligibility
acceptance_criteria: Castling enforces unmoved pieces, clear path, no check on traversed squares, and correct rook movement
En passant is permitted only immediately after the qualifying double pawn move and records canonical state
Promotion requires and applies queen, rook, bishop, or knight choices with correct captures and notation inputs
Each special move has focused positive and negative regression tests

chunks.title: Resolve terminal states and draws immutably
acceptance_criteria: Checkmate and stalemate are distinguished from ordinary check using legal-move availability
Repetition, move-count, dead-position, resignation, agreed-draw, and timeout result rules have explicit state/result representations or documented application boundaries
Claim-required draws expose an explicit claim action rather than ending automatically
No move or clock transition can mutate a finished game, with focused tests for every terminal path implemented in this sprint

chunks.title: Expose canonical notation and interchange
acceptance_criteria: Accepted moves produce standard algebraic notation for ordinary moves, captures, checks, mates, castling, and promotions
The canonical position can be represented as FEN and moves use a stable coordinate representation
The existing controller and browser smoke path retain their stable response envelope while consuming the upgraded domain state
Regression tests prove deterministic state, notation, and interchange for representative completed positions
